cases.current_observation: The four-row Paperwhite detail sheet retains the reference placement and border allocation. The common migration and delete-download captions are complete and use the reference ordinary-weight treatment, visibly separate from bold chapter titles. The visible provider is MangaDex. The disabled screensaver icon, caption and unavailable explanation stay within their row.

The Paperwhite Library More sheet has four readable ordinary-weight row captions with the reference control allocation. The category-management row contains a visible native list glyph and complete caption. The header, tabs, card grid, folio and bottom navigation retain the reference hierarchy. No sheet clipping or row overlap is observed.

The Scribe tap-region panel shows complete labels and three clear diagrams: thirds, L shape and swipe only. The selected black row, outlined alternatives, secondary toggle captions and separators follow the reference allocation. The selected sidebar caption and bottom Settings caption remain readable and differentiated from ordinary navigation captions. No visible clipping, missing glyph or control overlap is observed.

The secondary-page back chevron and Settings caption are readable and aligned like the original reference. Interval six is visibly selected. Chapter refresh explicitly reads Fixed on with a black on track and a gray right-side knob; rules, night-mode control, grayscale strip and navigation remain separated.

The back chevron, Settings caption and power-page title are complete. The wake switch, gray charging/network rows and their unavailable explanations remain within their row bounds. Three equal screensaver cards and their captions are readable; unavailable placeholders and the exit frame/button do not overlap.

The fresh native settings sidebar has readable group captions and complete menu labels, with Screen and refresh visibly selected. The content pane keeps the selected six-page interval, three contained unavailable quality cards with strong captions, explicit Fixed on chapter refresh, separate close-menu/night controls and grayscale strip. The selected reading-history underline stays inside its tab; the neighboring chapter-updates caption and count 6 remain distinct. The single-page folio 1/1 is readable and no next-page control is shown.

MangaDex remains a bold serif heading; the intrinsic Switch label and downward caret fit the matched control frame. The neutral filter outline, catalog tabs, grid captions, page marker and five bottom navigation captions are readable without overlap.
Both updatable rows show complete installed-to-target tokens, v12 to v13 and v8 to v9. Source names, icon squares, individual Update buttons and the bulk Update control remain separated and readable.
